khag ched dmigs g.yar stsal dang gus kyi mig lam du ma gyur pa'i dpe deb gzhan khag rgyus ston gnang ba/ gus kyis bris pa'i ru thog gi lo rgyus zin bris cha tshang gzigs zhib dang gal che'i bka' slob lan mang ru thog tu phebs te ru thog dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya bar byas rjes chen po 'jog gnang mdzad pa rje bla ma'i rnam thar nas shes thub/ rje tshul khrims nyi ma ni me pho 'brug ste phyi lo 1796 lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa phyi lo 1808 lor rje nyid kyi phu bor gyur pa tshong dpon tshe ring lhun grub byang ru thog tu tshong la 'gro ba'i skabs gnyer pa'i las sne'i thog 9 ri rdzong sras sprul blo bzang tshul khrims chos 'phel gyis brtsams pa nges pa don gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug rje tshul khrims nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa dad gsum nyin byed 'dren pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba ('di rjes grub dbang tshul khrims nyi ma'i rnam thar zhes 'god rgyu ) gus pa ru thog gi lo rgyus 'di bris skabs rnam thar 'di bzhin a myes rma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin mkhas dbang bkra shis tshe ring mtshag nas g.yar gnang byung bar bcos min bkrin che zhes zhu rgyu yin/ rnam thar 'di ni shog ldeb 598na nang ji ltar gsal yod ce na/ chu rta 1882 lo nang bstan pa'i gsal byed sras sprul pa'i sku blo bzang tshul khrims chos 'phel dang dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling gi gnas brtan chen po tshul khrims rdo rje bcas dbus phyogs su bskyod skabs dngos dang ngos phrad yang yang bgyis te rje bla ma gang de'i rnam par thar pa da lta phal cher zin bris su bkod de yod pa/ slar la dwags lo phyag pa bod bskyod skabs de lar nges 'byor 270 ru thogyin zer ba la rgyu mtshan phran tsam yod pa'i bzo 'dug bar skabs zhig gi ring la ru thog de bod kyi rgyal phran zhig yin pa dang / rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gi rjes su bod bka' shag srid gzhung nas gcig gyur gyis dbang 'dzin byas nas rdzong dpon mngag gtong byed srol chags pa red/gnyis pa/ ru thog gi srid dbang chags tshul skor/ bod yongs dang 'dra ba'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin 'og zhing bran lam lugs zhig yin pa de yang / mnga' ris la rgyal po gsum byung pa ni/ gu ge rgyal po dang / zangs dkar rgyal po/ mar yul ru thog rgyal po bcas byung nas stod mnga' ris skor gsum zer ba'i ming de byung ba min nam sems/ de gang yin zer na dus rabs dgu par bod kyi rgyal rabs la bran g.yog gi gyen langs byung bas bod kyi rgyal po'i gdung rgyud nyi ma mgon zhes pa zhig gis mi khag gcig khrid nas mnga' ris sa khul du bros phyin te rgyal po'i srid gzhung chung chung btsugs pa red/ rjes su nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris sa khul de lo pa'i bu gsum la bgos te bdag skyong byed du bcug ste mang yul (la dwags ) sa khul bu che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon dang / gu ge'i sa khul bu 'bring ba bkra shis lde mgon/ zangs dkar sa khul chung ba lde gtsug mgon bcas so sor sprad pa red/ dus rabs bcu pa'i nang byung ba'i lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces pa de ni gu ge rgyal po red/ bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags rta (spyi lo 1630)lor mar yul (la dwags ) rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal gyis gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal khab rtsa med du btang nas mnga' ris hril po btsan bzung byas nas lo ngo lnga bcu skor dbang sgyur byas pa red/ de ma zad 'brug pa bka' rgyud pa'i chos lugs phyogs la langs nas ta la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga par ngo rgol byed kyi yod par brten/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bod dmag btang ste mnga' ris khul du phar rgol byas pa de yi dmag dpon du rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gis mdzad de la dwags rgyal po'i dmag dpung mnga' ris nas gtor pham chen po btang ba ma zad/ rgyal kha thob mur la dwags mnga' khongs la dpung 'jug byas te la dwags kyi grong khyer lte ba slel yang tshur bzungs/ skabs der la dwags rgyal po bde legs rnam rgyal gyis ka shi rmi ri rgyal po la skyabs 'jug zhu dus ka si rmi ri rgyal pos dmag dpung khag gcig rgyab skyor byed par btang nas bod dmag dang dmag thengs gcig rgyab pas rgyal pham thag ma chod pa red/ bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu phag (spyi lo 1673) lor bod phyogs kyi la dwags dang 'dum 'grig byas te phyogs gnyis kyi gros mthun bzhag cing de'i nang don gzhi rkang thog 'di ltar te/ la dwags tā la'i bla ma'i mnga' 'og tu sdod rgyu dang / la dwags rgyal pos lo ltar ta la'i bla mar lo phyag ces pa'i 'bul mtshan 'bul rgyu/ bod phyogs nas lo ltar la dwags la ja khal rgyab nyis brgya re sprod rgyu/ mnga' ris sa khul tā la'i bla mas thad kur dpon rigs btang nas dbang sgyur byed rgyu bcas red/ de nas bzung la dwags tī la'i bla ma'i mnga' 'og tu
kha skang yig cha khag 271yod cing ca ching mnga' khongs gcig gyur dkar chag ces pa'i deb de'i bod kyi sa khra'i nang / la dwags sa khul de rbad de bod kyi mnga' khongs nang du bris yod/ bod rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa byi (spyi lo 1828) lor la dwags rgyal pos krang ker gyi ngan rogs lhag khro bzung nas byas rjes bzhag yod pa'i dbang gis ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung gis lo la rim pa lnga pa'i tog dang / rma bya'i sgro gdong gnang yod/ (shing rta 1834) lor ka shi rmi ri rgyal pos wo sir btang nas la dwags la btsan 'dzul byed skabs la dwags rgyal po tshe 'phel rnam rgyal pham ste rgyal po'i go gnas shor ba red/ bod pas la dwags la btsun 'dzul byed mkhan gyi mi de dag la sing pa zer gyi red/ de nas lcags glang (spyi lo 1841) lor sing pas slar yang mnga' ris la btsan 'dzug byas te mnga' ris sa khul hril po btsan bzung byas pa red/ bod bzhugs am ban gyis bka' blon tshe brtan rdo rje dang mda' dpon spel bzhi bod dmag dang bcas btang ste rgol lan sprod dus/ wo sir bsad thog sing pa rnams mnga' ris sa khul nas phyir skrod btang ba dang / de rjes sing dmag bod dang 'dum 'grig byas te la dwags nas phyir 'then byas rjes la dwags rgyal po tshe 'phel rnam rgyal gyi go gnas gzhi nas slar gso byung ste sngar ba'i na tā ga'i bla ma'i mnga' 'og tu bsdad te lo ltar lo phyag ces pa'i 'bul tshan 'bul gyi yod pa red/ bod rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu yos (1843) lor ka shi rmi ri rgyal pos slar yang dmag btang ste la dwags la btsan 'dzul byed skabs bod dmag gis glag ma 'khel bar la dwags nas phyir 'then pas ka shi rmi ris la dwags btsan bzung byas nas slar yang la dwags rgyal po tshe 'phel rnam rgyal pa'i go gnas med pa bzos thog rjes su la dwags tā la'i bla mar rogs skyor gyis la dwags dbang sgyur byed kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang ka shi rmi ri pas sngar bzhin la dwags dang / bod bar gyi sngar yod 'brel ba khas len gyi yod pa dang tā la'i bla mar 'bul tshan phul chog gi yod pa red/ me rta (1846)lor dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas ka shi rmi ri khyur mid btang thog la dwags ka shi rmi ri'i cha shas zhig yin pas dbyin ji'i khongs gtogs rgya gar srid gzhung gi dbang sgyur byed dgos par kha g.yar nas ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung la sa mtshams dbye 'byed nga gos pa'i blang bya bton yod kyang don dngos thog ma gzhi rang rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i la dwags dbyin jis btsan 'dzug byas zin de ching rgyal rabs srid gzhung nas khas len byed dgos zer pa red/ de ni dbyin ji'i mis bton pa'i blang bya lugs dang mi mthun pa de dang len ma byas pa zhig red/ rjes su la dwags kyi sa cha de ltar ha go 'di go med par dbyin jis btsan 'dzul byas pa red zer 'dug gong gsal rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gis g.yul las rnam par rgyal te stod mnga' ris bskor gsum dbang 'og tu bsdus shing / bod dang mnga' ris gcig gyur chen po bzos nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin srid dbang btsugs pa dang chabs gcig bod kyi mnga'

grwa tshang yin pas ma khag bcu bdun bgos nas khral bul skul gyi yod pa red/ gong gsal leb tsho dgu ni 'dur rgyug khral pa yin pas khral rigs sna tshogs rgyugs dgos pa dang / de 'phro zur sdod leb /gangs mar chod mar la bzhur song / /gangs yar chod yar la bzhur nas song / /gangs rgyal rmog tsam zhig dbu ru bzhag /de la mi rta byon pa yin/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje brag gis bskor ba la/ /bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad 'dug /gnam lcags thog chen 'bebs sa na/ /brag yan chad yar la gzhig nas song / /brag man chad mar la gzhig nas song / /brag rdo rje tsam zhig dbu la bzhag /de la mi rta byon pa yin/ /g.yon gsum tsandan nags kyis bskor/ /stag khra bo'i nyin lam bco brgyad 'dug /ltag khra bo ma thar 'gag ste 'dug /srid pa'i me phung spun dgu 'bar/ /nags yan chad yar la 'dug nas song / /nags man chad mar la 'dug nas song / /nags gzhu lcog tsam zhig dbu la bzhag /de la mi rta byon pa yin/ /sgo gsum mthing bran chab kyis bskor/ /nya skyu ru nyin lam bco brgyad 'dug /nya skyu ru ma thar 'gag ste 'dug /dgun zla gsum spun gsum shar sa na/ /chab yar chad yar la 'khyags nas song / /chab mar chab mar la 'khyags nas song / /chab yon chab tsam zhig dbu la bzhag /de la mi rta byon pa yin/nang gnya' na re/ khyed mgo la zhwa gcig 'dug zhwa yi rnam gsum shod/ /zhwa la thod gcig 'dug thod kyi rnam gsum shod/ /lus la gos cig 'dug gos kyi rnam gsum shod/ /lag la lcag gcig 'dug lcag gi rnam gsum shod/ /'og la rta gcig 'dug rta yi rnam gsum shod/ /don rgyas par shod cig dbang gi mi rta tsho/ phyi gnya' na re/ /gsan gcig bla ma gsan/ /mgon gcig bla ma mgon/ /khyed 'dra lta bu la//zhu lta mi 'tshal ste/ /'on kyang bdag la gsan/ /mgon la zhwa gcig yod/ /zhwa yi rnam gsum la//'dang zhwa sna ring gcig /btsun pa khong gi zhwa/ /gser chen 'bog to gcig /mi chen khong gi zhwa/ khrang zhwa phra skyi gcig /a rog bdag gi zhwa//zhwa yi rnam gsum yin/ /thod kyi rnams gsum ni//mdzang dkar lha yi thod/ /mdzang dmar btsan gyi thod/ /mdzang sngon klu yi thod/ /thod kyi rnam gsum yin/ /mthar rdung lcags kyi mtshon/ /ma brdung rwa yi mtshon/ /dar legs shing gi mtshon/ /mtshon gyi rnam gsum yin/ /gos kyi rnam gsum ni/ /chos gos ngur smrig gcig /yar 'dren bla ma'i gos/ /khrab dkar nyil pa zhig /stag shar dpa' bo'i gos/ /ljang chung thig khra zhig /sman chung bu mo'i gos/ /gos kyi rnam gsum yin/ /lag la lcag cig 'khyer/ /lcag gis rnam gsum ni/ /rba lcag dkar po gcig /gyi ling rta po'i lcag /lcag dkar lcug sgril cig /kum lcag dmar po cig /lcog rong bong bu'i lcag /lcag gi rnam gsum lags/ /'og ma rta cig 'dug /rta yi rnam gsum ni/ /phur shes rlung gi rta/ /gyi ling 'phrul gyi rta/ /'do ba 'gro ba'i rta/ /rta yi rnam gsum lags/ /zhu ches legs so/ /don rgyas par phul lo dbang gi mgron lags/ /nang gnya' na re/ /khyed dang po gros 'go su yis brtsams/ /gnyis pa gros thag su yis bcad/ /zhib 'bru 'thag pa su yis thags/ /chibs pa 'gugs pa zhig su yis 'gugs/ rgyags
294 ru thogbskur lam 'jug su yis byas/ /don rgyas par phul lo dbang gi mgron po lags/ phyi gnya' na re//gsan dang bla ma gsan/ /mgon cig bla ma mgon/ /khyed 'dra lta bu la/ /zhus dang mi 'tshal te/ /yud tsam bdag la gsan/ /dang po'i gros thag gcig yang mes rgan gyis brtsams/ /gnyis pa'i gros thag gcig yab yum gnyis kyis bcad/ /zhib 'bru 'thag pa gcig g.yog mo bzang gis thags/ /chibs pa 'gugs pa gcig a drung gi 'gugs/ /rgyags skur lam 'jug gcig yum chung ma yis bcug/don rgyas par phul lo dbang gi mgron lags zhus ches legs so/ nang gnya' na re/ /khyed dang po chom pa gang nas chom/ /de nas gros btab ga ru btab/ /de nas gsol chu gang nas len/ /de nas dgong mo ga ru gzim/ /de nas slobs pa ga ru slebs/ /don rgyas par shod gcig dbang gi mgron chen lags/phyi gag na re//gsan dang bla mas nas 'chus/ /de nas dgong gzim gcig gling du gzim/ /de nas slebs pa gcig mkhar du slebs/ /don rgyas par phul lo dbang gi mgron chen zhu ches lags so/ nang gtso na re/ /khyed dang po chom pa yul na gsol chu gcig mtsho nas 'chus/ /mtsho yi rnam gsum ni/ /ma pham khras kyi mtsho/ /gur rgyal sman gyi mtsho/ /la ngag bdud kyi mtsho/ /mtsho yi rnam gsum yin/ /dgong mo gzim pa gling du gzim/ /gling gi rnam gsum la//thogs med nam mkha'i gling //'gag med chos kyi gling //zad med nor gyi gling //gling gi rnam gsum yin/ /de nas slebs pa mkhar du slebs/ /mkhar gyi rnam gsum la/ /spyi bo gtsug lag mkhar/ /ltag mo zam bzo mkhar/ /mal 'jug dril bu mkhar/ /mkhar gyi rnam gsum yin/ /don rgyas par phul lo dbang gi mgron chen lags/ nang gag na re/ /khyed shar nas nub la mjal zer na/ /mjal sna ci dang gang la byas/ /lho nas byang la mjal zer na/ /mjal sna ci dang gang la byas/ /steng nas 'og la mjal zer na/ /mjal sna ci dang gang la byas/ /gnya' bo mi rta mjal zer na/ /mjal sna ci dang gang la byas//don rgyas par shod gcig dbang gi mi rta tsho/ phyi gtso na re /gsan dang bla ma gsan/ /mgon dang bla mas mgon/ /khyed 'dra lta bu la/ /zhus lta mi 'tshal te/ /yud tsam bdag la gsan/ khrar na nub la
kha skong yim cha khag 295mjal zer na/ /mjal sna gser chung nyi ma mjal/ /lho nas byang la mjal zer na/ /mjal sna g.yu 'brug sngon mos byas/ /'og nas steng du mjal zer na/ /mjal sna g.yu ljang sngon mos byas/ /gnya' po mi rta mjal zer na//mjal sna kha btags dkar pos byas//don rgyas par phul lo dbang gi mgron chen lags zhu ches legs so/ nang gnya' na re/ /khyed mdang dgong gcig nyal lugs ci 'dra byas/ /de ring snga mo gcig langs lugs ci 'dra byas/ /mnyes pa'i sku don de gang gi phyogs la yin/ phyi gnya' na re/ /mdang dgong dgong mo gcig 'brong po'i thor nyal brgyab/ /de ring snga mo cig shwa ba'i hrog la byas//mnyes pa'i sku don ni gnas khang 'di ru yin zhu ches legs so/ nang gnya' na re/ /g.yag rwa bdud kyi cho 'phrul de/ /bskyed na dga' dang skum na dga'/ /krad pa bdud kyi cho 'phrul de/ /brkyang na dga' dang skum na dga'/ /mi sho sog ma'i ban bun de/ /snga na dga' dang phyi na dga'/ /don rgyas par shod gcig dbang gi mi rta tsho/ phyi gnya' na re/ /gsan dang bla ma gsan/ /mgon dang bla mas mgon/ /khyed 'dra lta bu la/ /zhus lta mi 'tshal te/ /yud tsam bdag la gsan/ /g.yag rwa bdud kyi cho 'phrul de//bskyed na mi dga' skum na dga'/ /krad pa bdud kyi cho 'phrul de/ /brkyang na mi dga' skum na dga'//mi sho sog ma'i ban bun de/ /snga na mi dga' phyi na dga' zhu ches lags so/ de nas gnya' bo gnyis nang du log sgo'i ya them la rgyang 'bud zer ba'i snal ma tshos sna lnga kyang bshad pa rgyag rgyu'i glu ni 'di ltar/ phyi gnya' na re/ /'di rgyang 'bud dkar po zhig /dkar ra so dang sen mo dkar/ /so dang sen mo dkar ba'i glud la drongs/ /rgyang 'bud dmar po zhig /dmar ra snyig dang byu ru dmar/ /snyil dang byu ru dmar ba'i glud dang drongs/ /rgyang 'bud gser po zhig /gser ra gser dang rag gan ser//gser dang rag gan gser pa'i glud la drongs/ /rgyang 'bud sngon mo zhig /g.yu dang mkhris pa sngo//g.yu dang mkhris pa sngo ba'i glud la drongs/ /rgyang 'bud nag po zhig skra dang dreg pa nag /skra dang dreg pa nag pa'i glud la drongs/ zhes zer mda' rtses rgyang 'bud re re bcad/ de nang nang gnyas sgo rdog rdos mnan nas sgo bkag pa'i glu gtong / glu de nas 'dur ma yin par gdangs yin/ nang gnya' na re/ /kye lha swo/ /sgo me'i ya thim la lha chen tshangs pa gnas/ /lha de ma gsol na nang la 'dzul sa med/ /sgo mo'i sgo skyed la gzhung dmar brgya byin gnas//btsan de ma gsol na nang la 'dzul sa med/ /sgo mo'i mar them na na ro gzi chen gnas/ /klu de ma gsol na nang la byon sa med/ /sgo mo de la dog lha mgon po gnas/ /dog de ma dkrol na nang la byon sa med/ /don rgyas par shod cig dbang gi gnya' bo lags/ phyi gnya' na re//gsan dang bla ma gsan/ /mgon dang bla mas mgon/ /khyed 'dra lta bu la/ /zhus lta mi 'tshal te/ /yud tsam bdag la gsan/ /sgo mo'i ya them la lha chen tshangs pa gnas/ /lha de la lha dar dkar po 'dzugs kyin 'gro/ /sgo mo'i sgo skyed la gzhu dmar brgya byin gnas/ /btsan de la btsan dar dmar po 'dzugs kyin 'gro/ /sgo mo'i ma them la na ro zil chen gnas/ /klu de la klu dar sngon po 'dzugs kyin
296 ru thog'gro/ /sgo de la dog lha mgon po gnas/ /dog lta mgon po nas bzhu lag gso/ /de nas rdog bkyag zhu nas sgo yar 'bud de yang bskyar sgo bshad kyi glu btang ba ni/ /'di gser sgo ser po zhig yar 'dren bla ma'i sgo//de sngar yang 'dzul ma myong da yang 'dzul dgos med/ /'di mtshal sgo dmar po chig 'go 'dren dpon po'i sgo/ /de sngar yang 'dzul ma myong da yang 'dzul dgos zer/ /'di mchong sgo smug po cig gnyen drung 'dzoms pa'i sgo/ /de sngar yang 'dzul ba yin da yang 'dzul gyi yin/ sgo yar 'dzul dang mchod gnas mjal pa'i glu gtong rgyu/ /dkyil 'khor chen po zhig padma'i khri steng na/ /yi dam chen po zhig bcom ldan shākya thub bzhugs/ /sra shing ldan pa zhig ri bos chos sgra sgrog /de la gdams ngag bzang po zhig nam mkha'i glog dang mnyam/ /thugs rje khyad par can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zer nas mgo gur gur lan gsum byas nas mda' dar dpangs bstod zer ba mda' ke snal ma dkar po dkri ba dang mjug tu mde'u rtse la bya sgro sne gsum yod pa sre long dang dngul dkar me long sogs btags yod pa dar tshon sna lnga yod pa gser 'phang g.yu lo zer pa'i 'phang zhig la snal ma dmar po dkris yod pa dang tshos gzhi ser po dang ljang khu g.yu'i lo ma yod pa dang / lha'i bgrang rgyas cig dang srid pa ho gcig dang rag kong cig mar mes bskangs nas khyer yong ba de re re bzhin mchod nas phul dgos pa 'phul pa'i skabs mdangs bcug ste phul dgos/ dgung sngon mthon po cig rag kong lder legs 'dra/ /de dkar gsal zla ba cig res dkar sdong ras btsugs/ /de ser chung nyi ma cig mar khu'i rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /de bka' sprin 'dzom po cig rag dkar mar me phye/ /de thub pa rig bzang cig bon bo'i phyag tu phul/ (rag kong ) 'di 'grang rgyas zhal dkar cig lto nas ma nyams yod/ /mar dkar dar 'khru cig ma zhu ma khyag yod/ /'di thub pa rigs bzang cig bon bo'i phyag la phul/ (gra rgyas ) /'di mda' smyug tshig gsum cig rtsi kha ma nyam yod//bal skud gsum gsum sgrim cig gnyen lam ma chad yod/ /gnam lcags mde'u gcig rno ngar ma nyams yod/ /mda' sgo spun gsum cig sgro sne ma nyams yod/ /'di mtshal stod dmar po gcig stod kha ma nyams yod/ /sre long smug chung cig khog snum ma yal yod/ /'di dngul dkar me long cig ma yo ma gas yod/ /dar tshon sna lnga cig tshos mdog ma nyams yod/ /'di thub pa rig bzang cig bon po'i phyag tu phul (mda' phul ) /ser phang g.yu lo cig ma yo ma gas yod/ /bal skud gsum lam cig gnyen lam ma chad yod/ /'di thub pa rigs bzang cig bon po'i phyag la phul/ (phang phul )/'di gab rtse gling gzhi cig gling phran ma nyams yod/ /de kha btags dkar gtsang cig nag kha ma phog yod/ /'di thub pa rigs bzang cig bon pa'i phyag tu phul/(gab rtse phul ) der gdan sna tshogs rtsags tho rgyab nas yod par phyi gnya' nas gdan la ma zhugs bar gdan glu 'di ltar len//gos gdan 'ja' tshon cig bzang gsum bla ma'i gdan/ /sngar yang 'ding ma myong da yang mi 'ding ngo / /stag gdan khra'o cig 'go 'dren dpon gyi gdan/ /sngar yang 'ding ma myong da yang mi 'ding ngo / /rko gdan nag chung cig g.yag rdzi rgan po'i gdan/ /sngar yang 'ding
kha skong yin cha khag 297ma myong da yang mi 'ding ngo / /ra lpags dkar chung cig ra rdzi yon ngo 'i gdan/ /sngar yang 'ding ma myong da yang mi 'ding ngo / /tsher se bi si cig bya dang byi'u'i gdan/ /sngar yang 'ding ma myong da yang mi 'ding ngo / /rnam dkar zhug ring 'di mnya' bo rgan po'i gdan/ /sngar yang 'ding la dar yang 'ding / zhes de nas sngar bzhin yod pa'i bzhugs gral rmang ga'i thog phyi nas yong pa'i gnya' bo dang 4nya' rogs sogs kyang gral du 'khod/ de nas ja chang gi 'dren glu sogs mu mthud de 'bul pa dang / la gro pa'i gro ma yang 'beb de nas gzhung glu bkra shis bcu gsum glu'i 'go dang po phyi gnya' nas phul yang ja chang sga 'dren zhu sogs byas/ de nas phyi gnya' yar langs nas bzung ba zhags pa zer pa'i glu len pa dang la btags tshad dang ldan pa'i dkar gtsang cig lag tu khyer te na re/ /bzung ba zhags pa cig steng mchog lha la g.yogs/ /stong 'di lha yi cig bu mo bar ma 'dzin/ /'dzin yang 'dzin tsam la khyer yang khyer rgyu min/ /bzung ba zhags pa cig bar phyogs btsan la g.yogs/ /bar ta btsan gyi cig bu mo bar ma 'dzin/ /'dzin yang 'dzin tsam la khyer yang khyer rgyu min/ /bzung ba zhags pa cig 'og phyogs klu la g.yog /'og tu klu yi cig bu mo bar ma 'dzin/ /'dzin yang 'dzin tsam la khyer yang khyer rgyu min/ /bzung ba zhags pa cig gling dkar stod la g.yogs/ /gling dkar stod kyi cig shel lcam 'brug mor g.yogs/ /'dzin yang 'dzin rgyu yin la khyer yang khyer rgyu yin/ /bzung ba zhags pa cig rgya yi yul la g.yogs/ /rgya yi yul gyi cig rgya mo kong jo 'dzin/ /'dzin yang 'dzin rgyu yin la khyer rgyu yin/ /bzung ba zhags pa cig pha bzang grong la g.yogs//pha bzang bu mo cig bar ma'i ske la g.yogs/ /'dzin yang 'dzin rgyu yin la khyer yang khyer rgyu yin/g.yang dar 'di mchan 'og tu mdud pa cig rgyab ste bag rogs kyis lag tu sprad/ de nas phyi gnya' dang bag rogs sogs kyis bu mo yar blang ste khrid/ sgo yi nang khug tu kha yar 'khor te phyag 'bul ba'i glu len pa/ /yab chen a pha gser khri steng la bzhugs/ /phyag skyed skyed skyed la phyag gsum 'tshal/ /phyag skyed ma thud la phyag gsum 'tshal//yum chung a ma g.yu khri steng du bzhugs/ /skyed skyed la phyag gsum 'tshal/ /skyed ma thud la phyag gsum 'tshal/ /jo co ming chung cig dung khri steng du bzhugs/ /skyed skyed la phyag gsum 'tshal/ /skyed ma thud la phyag gsum 'tshal/ zer pa dang sgo'i phyir don pa dang mnyam du g.yang 'gugs pa'i glu len 'di ltar te/ /dgung sngon mthon po gcig phywa yul g.yang yul la/ /nyi zla gnyis po cig 'khrangs pa'i 'khrungs yul yin/ /skar phran 'dzoms po cig phywa dang g.yang la zhugs/ /dgon chung gru bzhi cig phywa yul g.yang yul la/ /yar 'dren bla ma cig 'khrungs pa'i 'khrungs yul yin/ /grwa btsun 'dzom po cig phywa dang g.yang la zhugs/ /sku mkhar mthon po cig phywa yul g.yang yul la/ /mi chen gong ma cig bzhugs pa'i bzhugs yul yin/ /rta dmag 'dzoms po cig phywa dang g.yang la zhugs/ /dpal khang gru bzhi cig phywa yul g.yang yul la//khyim bdag dpal skye cig bzhugs pa'i bzhugs yul yin//gnyen drung 'dzoms po cig phywa dang g.yang la zhugs/ de nas lam du mi 'phrad tshad kyis ser skyems kyi glu 'bul dgos te/ /'di gser
298 ru thogskyems gtsang ma zhig dgra lha'i zhal du mchod/ /dgra lha rta gdug dkar po'i zhal du mchod/ /'di gser skyems gtsang ma zhig pho lha'i zhal du mtshad/ /pho lha lha chen zhig ge khod kyi zhal du mtshad 'di gser skyems gtsang zhig mgon gzhi'i zhal du mched/ /mgon gzhi tshas skyong srung ma'i zhal la mchod//'di gser skyems gtsang ma zhig yul sa'i zhal du mtshab//yul sa'i gzhi bdag zhig gnyan pa'i zhal du mchod/ /'di gser skyems gtsang ma khrom pa'i zhal du mtshad/ /khrom pa 'dir tshogs kyi dbu 'phang zhal du mchod /ba btags dkar gtsang gcig gangs dkar do shal can/ /kha btags dkar kha de gtsang pa de nas byung / /gos chen 'thag sa de zhig rgya nag yul du 'thag /de gos chen ri mo legs pa snga nas byung / /sman rtse 'thag sa shig la dwags yul du btags/ /sman rtse tshos gzhi mdzes pa de nas byung / /'di bkra la shis pa'i gcig mgul dar ske la g.yogs/ /'di don la grub pa'i glu gar gcig sems la bcangs/ bu mo bag rogs gnya' bo bcas khyim nang du slebs pa dang gnya' ponas mda' gsar dpang༄da kyi glu cha tshang zhig dang /rag skyong ther legs/'grang rgyas/gser phang g.yu log ba rtse sogs glu gtang nas tshang ma mtshad gnas kyi phyag tu 'bul dgos/chang bkag pa'i glu//srid pa ma chags gong rol na/ /ko lo mi chung ci la chags /ri'u ma chags gong rol na/ /ri dwags kya mo ci la chags/ /mtsho mo ma chags gong rol na/ :nya sbal lcong gsum ci la chags/ yang min na de 'dra'i mtshan nyid bshod/ /yang min na gsu ma chang 'dren pas mchod/ lan du/ /srid pa ma chags gong rol na/ /ko lo mi chung spra la chags/ /ri'u ma chags gong rol na/ /ri dwags kya mo 'bur la chags/ /mtsho mo ma chags gong rol na/ /nya sbal lcong gsum gsher la chags/ /gsum chang yar mchod yar la mchod/ /ser mo mi mchod gang yang med/ yang / /ko ko g.yag gi gung thur na/ /bskor lam cha drug ya dang bdun/ /cag cag rgan mo gung thur na/ /dar go cha drug ya dang bdun/ /dmig pa rgya 'o rnga ma na/ /sag bsdar cha drug ya dang bdun/ /yang min na de 'dra'i mtshan nyid shod/ /yang min na gsum chang 'dren pas mchod/ lan du/ /ko ko g.yag gi gung thur na/ /bskor lam cha drug ya dang bdun/ /de ko ko 'bu la yod tog med/ /byang mi med rnam lung kyog mo na/ /'brong ma brgyas gsos pa'i bu cig yod/ /de tsam tsam la mi bzhu 'e/ /cag cag rgan mo gung thur na/ /dar go cha drug ya dang bdun/ /de cag cag 'bu la yod tog med/ /rgya ling mkhar gang bar ma na/ /dar go can rtsig pa ri las mtho/ /de tsam tsam la mi bzhu 'e/ /dmigs pa rgya 'o rnga ma na/ /sag bsdar cha drug ya dang bdun//de dmigs pa 'bu la yod tog med/ /de mgar re mgar khang gru bzhi na/ /sag bsdar cha drug ya dang bdun/ de tsam tsam la mi bzhu 'e/ /gsum chang yar mchod yar la mchod/ /ser mo mi mchod gang yang med/ /'dir de tsam gyis 'thus par byas so//
kha skong yig cha khag 299chang glu//stod rgya gar yul dang rgya nag yul/ /stod rgya gar yul du chos cig dar/ /chos ma dar sngon la dung cig dar/ /dung dkar po chos kyi sne khrid yin/ /bar dbus gtsang yul du glu cig dar/ /glu ma dar sngon la chang cig dar/ /chang ser mo glu'i sne khrid yin/ /smad rgya nag yul du khrims cig dar/ /khrims ma dar sngon la dar cig dar/ /dar dkar po khrims kyi sna khrid yin/ /yab a ba'i gong mdzod gong ma na/ /dar gos can rtsig pa ri la mtho/ /dar gos can gong ka ma chod 'dug /gyi re gong thang dgra la bsgyur/ /yab a bas gong mdzod bar ma na/ /ja khag drug rtsig pa shes rgya mtshor bod yig gi rmang gzhi cung legs tsam yod kyang rgya yig slob skabs slob ma gzhan ltar 'go nas slob rgyu las dmigs bsal gang yang med la 'tsho ba'i goms 'dris kyang slob ma gzhan ltar 'go nas sbyong rgyu de yin/ ye shes rgya mtshos rang gi pha ma gnyis kyis g.yogs pa'i slog pa de tsha ba che ba'i zhan yang du bed spyod byed thabs med kyang de nam yang bskyur mi rung ba'i dngos po rtsa chen zhig tu brtsis te ras dkar po gtsang ma zhig gi nang bsgril nas slob grwa'i dngos bcol khang du bzhag nas ca ga byas/ res gza' nyi ma zhig la slob grogs gzhan gnyis dang mnyam du ye shes rgya mtshos slob grwas sprad pa'i gos thung stod thung gsar pa de gyon nas zhan yang grong khyer gyi khrom gzhung du so sman nyo bar song / skabs der zhan
342 ru thogyang du 'byor nas gza' 'khor gcig tsam las song med pa'i slob ma de gsum po nas pha ma bu phrug dga' 'dzoms kyis mtshan mo phyi po bar du ma nyal bar phan tshun gtam gleng byas nas bsdad/ye
